classification: Authored future custody requirements, not a paper-reported tracking system
lineage: Cell acceptance + aliquot -> loaded child state -> settled initial state
Settled state + approved condition + calibration/clock map -> immutable run
Run -> raw sensor stream and image stream -> versioned derived products
Spent run -> closed service safe-state receipt -> disposition; any reloading receives a new child/run ID
custody_rules: Every transfer checks matching label, orientation, container closure and contamination condition
Same cell identifier does not mean the same grain microstate; previous displacement makes the state history-dependent
Do not assume reset/reuse between phi, reservoir or rate points; source practice is insufficiently specified
Retain failed and censored runs with reason; never overwrite source or original observations
A pressure-cell dock carries contained specimens; no robot uncoupling until qualified-service safe-release receipt
